def solve():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    t = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        s = input[ptr]
        ptr += 1
        sorted_s = sorted(s)
        if s == sorted_s:
            print(0)
            continue
        k = 0
        left = 0
        for right in range(n):
            if s[right] != sorted_s[right]:
                k += 1
                while left < right and s[left] == sorted_s[left]:
                    left += 1
                left += 1
        print(k)

solve()
